sources.title: 臺灣2050淨零排放路徑及策略總說明
sources.title_en: Taiwan's Pathway to Net-Zero Emissions in 2050
sources.publisher: 國家發展委員會 National Development Council
sources.note: The 2050 power mix (renewables 60-70%, hydrogen 9-12%, thermal with carbon capture 20-27%) is quoted from this document in the power-system action plan (ndc_2050_grid_storage, PDF p. 3). The PDF itself could not be downloaded by script (HTTP 403, bot protection, 2026-09-24): to verify by hand.

sources.short_cite: Taiwan 2050 net-zero pathway: wind and solar (Strategy 1)
sources.title: 臺灣2050淨零轉型「風電/光電」關鍵戰略行動計畫（核定本）
sources.title_en: Taiwan 2050 net-zero transition, key strategy action plan: wind and solar power
sources.publisher: 經濟部 Ministry of Economic Affairs
sources.note: Offshore wind 40-55 GW in 2050, moving toward floating (PDF p. 10). Solar 40-80 GW in 2050, 50-100 TWh/yr (PDF p. 15). Used as the 2050 capacity ranges in sector_path_2050_official.yaml.

sources.title: 臺灣2050淨零轉型「前瞻能源」關鍵戰略行動計畫（核定本）
sources.title_en: Taiwan 2050 net-zero transition, key strategy action plan: forward-looking energy (geothermal, biomass, ocean)
sources.publisher: 經濟部 Ministry of Economic Affairs
sources.note: 2050 targets: geothermal 3-6.2 GW, biomass 1.4-1.8 GW, ocean 1.3-7.5 GW (PDF p. 6). Geothermal range used in sector_path_2050_official.yaml; biomass and ocean are not bounded in the model.

sources.short_cite: Taiwan 2050 net-zero pathway: geothermal targets (2 GW in 2040, 6 GW in 2050)
sources.title: 再生能源突破-地熱減碳旗艦行動計畫（核定本）
sources.title_en: Renewable energy breakthrough: geothermal flagship action plan (approved)
sources.publisher: 行政院 Executive Yuan / 經濟部 MOEA
sources.note: Vision of 200 MW (2030), 2 GW (2040) and 6 GW (2050) (PDF p. 1). The forward-energy action plan gives 3-6.2 GW for 2050 (see ndc_2050_forward_energy). Used as the 6 GW cap in sensitivity D and the 3-6.2 GW range in the official pathway.

sources.title: 臺灣2050淨零轉型「氫能」關鍵戰略行動計畫（核定本）
sources.title_en: Taiwan 2050 net-zero transition, key strategy action plan: hydrogen
sources.publisher: 經濟部 Ministry of Economic Affairs
sources.note: Hydrogen 9-12% of power in 2050 (PDF pp. 6, 8). Domestic renewable hydrogen may be insufficient; imports through international cooperation, including liquid hydrogen (PDF pp. 5, 8). 2030 KPIs: 91 MW gas-hydrogen co-firing, 800 MW coal-ammonia co-firing (PDF p. 6).

sources.short_cite: Taiwan 2050 net-zero pathway: power system and storage (Strategy 5)
sources.title: 臺灣2050淨零轉型「電力系統與儲能」關鍵戰略行動計畫（核定本）
sources.title_en: Taiwan 2050 net-zero transition, key strategy action plan: power system and energy storage
sources.publisher: 經濟部 Ministry of Economic Affairs
sources.note: Quotes the NDC pathway (2022-03): in 2050 renewables 60-70%, hydrogen 9-12%, thermal with carbon capture 20-27% (PDF p. 3). Battery storage 1.5 GW in 2025 and 5.5 GW in 2030; 2031-2050 targets to be set later; new pumped hydro at Guangming and Shimen (PDF p. 15). Used for sector_path_2050_official_mix.yaml.

sources.short_cite: Taiwan 2050 net-zero pathway: negative emissions and CCUS (Strategy 6)
sources.title: 臺灣2050淨零轉型「碳捕捉利用及封存」關鍵戰略行動計畫
sources.title_en: Taiwan 2050 net-zero transition, key strategy action plan: carbon capture, utilisation and storage
sources.publisher: 國科會、經濟部、環保署 (NSTC, MOEA, EPA)
sources.note: Downloaded 2026-09-26. The plan gives 2030 CCUS targets of 1.74-4.6 Mt CO2/yr (PDF p. 19) but no 2050 storage volume in its text: the 40.2 Mt CO2/yr of negative emissions in 2050 (search summary) is still to verify, probably in the NDC pathway document itself. Used for sector.co2_sequestration_potential = 40 in sector_path_2050.yaml.

sources.short_cite: Taiwan 2050 net-zero pathway: carbon-free and electric vehicles (Strategy 7)
sources.title: 臺灣2050淨零轉型「運具電動化及無碳化」關鍵戰略行動計畫
sources.title_en: Taiwan 2050 net-zero transition, key strategy action plan: vehicle electrification and decarbonisation
sources.publisher: 交通部 Ministry of Transportation and Communications
sources.note: Table 3 (PDF p. 22): electric share of new passenger cars 30% (2030), 60% (2035), 100% (2040); of new motorcycles 35%, 70%, 100%; stock 3.03 million electric cars (43.2%) and 8.86 million electric motorcycles (63.3%) in 2040; totals 7.2 million cars and 14.38 million motorcycles in 2022. All motorcycles electric before 2050 (PDF p. 29). The road energy shares in sector_path_2050.yaml (5/45/85% electric in 2030/2040/2050) are derived from these, not published.

sources.short_cite: NETL, updated cost and performance of power plants with carbon capture (2023)
sources.title_en: NETL's Updated Performance and Cost Estimates for Power Generation Facilities Equipped with Carbon Capture (webinar, Cost and Performance Baseline Rev. 4a)
sources.publisher: U.S. DOE National Energy Technology Laboratory (NETL)
sources.note: H-class NGCC: total overnight cost 970 $/kW without capture (B32A) and 1,980 $/kW with 95% capture (B32B.95) (PDF p. 17, 2018$); LHV net efficiency 61.0% and 54.0% (PDF p. 36). Used as factors 2.041 and 0.885 on the CCGT row for 'CCGT CC' in sector_path_2050_official.yaml.

sources.short_cite: Hampp, Düren & Brown (2023), import options for chemical energy carriers
sources.title_en: Import options for chemical energy carriers from renewable sources to Germany
sources.note: 2050 delivered costs to Germany: ammonia 242-330 EUR/t at 5% p.a. WACC and 360-492 EUR/t at 10% (PDF p. 25); FT fuels by ship 90-256 EUR/MWh at 5% WACC; every carrier from every exporter at 100 EUR/MWh or less at 5% WACC (PDF pp. 26-27); shipped CH4(l) from Morocco in 2030 82 (5%) to 120 (10%) EUR/MWh (PDF p. 25). Basis for the import prices in sector_path_2050_official_imports.yaml.

sources.short_cite: Ammonia Energy Association, The cost of CO2-free ammonia
sources.note: Renewable ammonia from Australia delivered to Japan, about US$4.4/kg-H2 (about US$700/t NH3). Upper end of the price basis for sensitivity C; to verify.

sources.short_cite: Ammonia Energy Association, ammonia-fueled gas turbines: technology and deployment update
sources.title_en: Ammonia-fueled gas turbines: a technology and deployment update
sources.note: Ammonia-fired combined cycles at 60% (LHV) or more against 63% or more for natural gas at the 1,650 C class (search summary; to verify). Used as efficiency factor 0.95 for NH3 CCGT in sector_path_2050_official_imports.yaml.

sources.short_cite: IRENA, Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2023 (geothermal)
sources.note: Geothermal global weighted-average total installed cost 4,589 USD/kW in 2023 (range 3,413-6,595). Used as 4.22 million EUR/MW (at 0.92 EUR/USD) in sensitivity D; to verify.
